metadataContext: Retained SDK metadata; not a live release manifest or native admission for all blocks.

blocks.name: Anti-Snipe
blocks.summary: Caps early buys and adds an LP fee in the first blocks

blocks.name: Dynamic fees
blocks.summary: Fee scales with how far a swap moves the price

blocks.name: Auto Burn
blocks.summary: Burns a share of actual buy output

blocks.name: LP Rewards
blocks.summary: An extra LP fee on buys that in-range LPs keep

blocks.name: Arb recapture
blocks.summary: Pool keeps price-gap profit

blocks.name: Buy/Sell Block
blocks.summary: Pauses buys and locks sells for a set time after launch

blocks.name: Agent gate
blocks.summary: Only ERC-8004 agents can buy, sell or add liquidity; removing is never gated

blocks.name: Market Guard
blocks.summary: Swaps that stray from a live Chainlink price pay the pool's LPs a surcharge

blocks.name: Market-hours fee
blocks.summary: A fee that follows the US stock market's sessions

blocks.name: Managed fee
blocks.summary: A surcharge Hookr's keeper moves as the price moves, inside a cap you fix at launch

blocks.name: Zap Relay source
blocks.summary: Routes a cut of every buy to a zap vault that buys another pool

blocks.name: Zap Relay target
blocks.summary: Only zaps from its source pools may buy, and anyone may sell

blocks.name: Swap Reward Mint
blocks.summary: Pays traders a reward token for each swap, funded by a slice of the trade

blocks.name: Usage fee
blocks.summary: Hook Blocks Market block: every swap pays a usage fee to its builder, backers, Hookr and a reserve

blocks.name: Pay Later
blocks.summary: Buyers pay a premium now for the right to buy at a fixed price later

blocks.name: Exit Clock
blocks.summary: The sell fee falls with the pool's age, or with each seller's time held on a per-holder clock

blocks.name: Holder Pot
blocks.summary: Sandwich Guard's charges pay holders daily, by amount and time held

blocks.name: Storm Fee
blocks.summary: The fee rises when the price gets choppy and eases as it calms, within launch limits

blocks.name: Wallet Cap
blocks.summary: No wallet can buy more than a set share of the supply while the launch guard lasts

blocks.name: Swap Cut
blocks.summary: Takes a fixed cut of each buy and each sell, set at launch, for the pool's liquidity owner

blocks.name: Sandwich Guard
blocks.summary: A swap that moves the price back toward where its window opened pays that move, up to a maximum, and so does a sandwich inside one window
